summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time capture/clear logic, progress.elapsed default style, and Palette.__rich__ in the rich repo, plus tests (test_time_elapsed_column, test_columns update, tests/test_palette.py) and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry.
